title: Control of representation updating by higher-order thalamus enables history-based decision-making
goal: Reproduce and improve the original Figure 3C PPC recent-tone-context/prevalence decoding result for all 17 source recording sessions, six tones and both laser OFF/ON conditions, using the original per-session 70/30 training/held-trial support. Reproduction assesses native predictions/AUCs and original decoding controls. Improvement means meaningful predictive-AUC gain over the qualified author decoder under identical original support. Biological perturbation effects and Figure 3G remain separately versioned context.
primary_outputs: Complete source-support prediction/observation evidence and independently derived original metric families. Full prediction arrays are derivation evidence, not a requirement for pointwise equality to author predictions.
Independent reproduction against qualified full-precision source references.
Independent meaningful improvement against qualified published and strongest relevant author baseline on identical original support.
Separate paper_data and paper_data_author_code outcomes with matched scientific inputs and protected targets; all outcomes currently unknown.
success_criteria: Reproduction and improvement are independent outcomes for the selected original computational result; neither is inferred from metadata or success in the other.
Preserve all source support, observations/preprocessing exposure, original split, metric and aggregation in the selected contracts.
Require authentic execution, complete granular outputs and independent source verification; unresolved numeric references, criteria and runtime remain blocking.

Improvement must beat the qualified source-paper and relevant author baseline under a justified complete-panel rule; no alternative split/metric, biological-effect maximization or favorable subset substitutes.
The two information conditions differ only by allowlisted author code; scientific inputs, targets and cumulative budgets are matched.
Retained biology and existing local calibration are versioned context, not new primary prerequisites or readiness evidence.

Numerical reproduction evaluates declared original metric families and authenticated original source-selected displays only. Complete predictions/observations remain mandatory provenance for metric derivation; they need not equal all author predictions pointwise. Improvement remains independently assessed and is never gated on reproducing author prediction bodies.

primary_improvement.improvement_loop: No final-test feedback under this unqualified proposal. After qualification, iterate using source-matched training and declared validation feedback with cumulative accounting.
primary_improvement.candidate_freeze: Freeze method/code, source support and preprocessing exposure, original partitions, author baseline, complete-family scientific comparison and cumulative budgets before final evaluation.
primary_improvement.final_evaluation: Independently execute the frozen candidate on complete original held support and compare source-native output/metric families with qualified published and strongest relevant author references; report both outcomes independently for each information condition.
primary_improvement.baseline_policy: Calibrate the complete published Figure 3C prediction/AUC result and the strongest relevant original-author rerun on the same original inputs/partitions. Resolve source-auto pROC semantics explicitly; probability-MAE, fixed-positive substitutions and new splits do not establish paper improvement.
